structured.approach: Read all step inputs, mainly task.components FC-1 to FC-10, feat.design B4 and feat.screens FS-1/FS-2. Checked the blast radius with codegraph (impact/callers) before editing. Implemented FC-1 to FC-7 as an additive change to src/ap_portal/index.js and left all existing lines unchanged. Ran node ci.mjs: compile and static checks pass, but coverage is 59.02 against the gate of 90, because the new code has no tests and tests/ is outside this step's write scope (FE-05 owns it). Documented the module in README.md and a new docs/ap_portal.md. Deferred the version step (FC-8/FC-9) because package.json is out of scope and no input gives the next number. Raised the coverage contradiction as a BLOCKING question to the step owner instead of working around it.

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk(rows) was added and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary. The existing exports are unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or [], throws TypeError for a non-array rows value or a non-integer days, and otherwise renders <table class="overdue-risk"> with a plain header row and one risk-classed row per input row in the given order.
Amounts are padded to two decimals on the string only, through a regex check. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never used, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped for &, <, >, " and '. A risk value outside high, medium, low, unknown renders risk-unknown.
node ci.mjs reports compile true, tests_run 2, failures 0, no static issues and coverage 59.02, so passed is false against the gate of 90.
The step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so tests/portal.test.js and package.json were not changed.
codegraph shows formatAmount is called only by renderAgingSummary, so the additive change touches no existing caller.
README.md was updated and docs/ap_portal.md was added. Together they document the signatures, inputs, outputs, errors and a synthetic example.

Version step FC-8/FC-9 (DD-11): no input gives the next version number, and package.json is outside FE-04's write scope. Who sets the number, and in which step are VERSION and package.json changed together? Owner: Developer / Frontend lane.
Carried CQ-FE-1: should a missing or non-string id or vendor throw TypeError instead of rendering String(value)? Owner: Architect.
Carried CQ-FE-2: who styles overdue-risk and the risk-* classes, given that no tokens exist? Owner: UX lead.
